scope: Offline read-only MCHQ replay. No live configuration, ATSC reconstruction, or deployment.
filter: H_lambda(f)=conj(X(f))/(abs(X(f))^2+lambda*median(abs(X(f))^2)); channel 0 reference and channels 1..4 noncoherently summed.
selection_rule: Freeze only a loading that retains r277 over its parameter-trial-aware whole-map control p99. No miss is evaluated or selected unless this gate passes.
tradeoff: Lower loading flattens the reference spectrum but raises equal-response noise gain (about +6.62 dB at lambda=0.01); heavier loading reduces that gain but restores more matched-filter sidelobe structure. None retains r277.
decision: Rejected before miss scoring. The best positive-control choice (lambda=1.0) remains 3.41 dB below the parameter-trial-aware whole-map p99, so no loading can be frozen without post-hoc exception. r12/r94/r620/r623 are intentionally not tested under this failed gate; a miss-only result would not meet the stated acceptance contract.
